title.en: Training and inference: AdamW, tying, caches, and decoding
title.zh: 训练与推理：AdamW、权重共享、缓存及解码

en.a: Training and inference turn the Transformer block into an executable system: updates choose the parameter path, caches reuse the attention path, and decoding chooses the next-token path.
en.b: The objective remains a prefix-conditioned next-token distribution; smoothing, tying, caching, and decoding alter optimization, representation sharing, computation, or sampling around that distribution.

zh.a: 训练和推理将 Transformer 块转化为可执行系统：更新选择参数路径，缓存复用注意力路径，而解码选择下一 token 路径。
zh.b: 目标仍然是前缀条件化的下一 token 分布；平滑、权重共享、缓存和解码会围绕该分布改变优化、表示共享、计算或采样。
